landing.title: CitySync
landing.subtitle: Intelligent Urban Complaint Routing
landing.whatIsText1: CitySync is an AI-powered urban complaint management platform designed to bridge the gap between citizens and municipal authorities. It enables users to report civic issues such as potholes, garbage, water leaks, and infrastructure damage in a simple and efficient way.
landing.whatIsText2: Using intelligent algorithms, CitySync automatically classifies complaints, assigns priority based on urgency, and routes them to the appropriate departments. With real-time tracking and map-based visualization, the platform ensures transparency, faster resolution, and improved city governance.
landing.whatIsText3: CitySync transforms traditional complaint systems into a smart, data-driven solution that empowers both citizens and authorities to build cleaner, safer, and more responsive cities.
landing.p1Desc: Our system uses advanced AI to instantly identify civic issues like road damage or water leaks. It automatically sets priority based on urgency and impact, ensuring critical problems are resolved first without manual sorting.
landing.p2Desc: Every complaint is instantly routed to the correct municipal department based on issue type and geo-location. This completely eliminates manual delays and significantly accelerates operational efficiency.
landing.p3Desc: Monitor complaints in real-time through an interactive, geo-tagged map. Complete visibility across Pending, In Progress, and Resolved statuses builds ultimate trust between citizens and civic authorities.
landing.whatsappDesc: No app installation required. Any citizen can seamlessly report municipal issues by sending a simple text or an image directly via WhatsApp or SMS. Our system instantly parses the data, registers a formal complaint, and provides continuous, up-to-date tracking notifications directly back into their chat thread.
